b) Reference: the Brussels sprouts are about 3 cm across. The plate's width spans roughly 9-10 sprout-lengths across the visible square, which gives about 27-30 cm. The cauliflower florets (about 4 cm) across the lower left edge also suggest roughly 26 cm.
